title: Cleaning Estimate Template: House and Commercial, PDF, Word, Excel
description: Quote house or office cleaning from your browser: frequency, scope, supplies, start date. No sign-up. PDF, Word and Excel, with US price ranges and sources.
lede_html: Quote a recurring or one-time clean in this form and download a PDF, Word or Excel file. No account. The sample is a small office. Enter your client and their rooms.

sample.scope: Clean a 2,400 sq ft office, 3 times per week after 6 pm: floors, restrooms, break room, trash, high-touch surfaces. Supplies included.
sample.exclusions: Window exteriors, carpet extraction, biohazard waste, medical instruments.
sample.terms: Monthly billing in advance. Either side may end with 30 days written notice.

must_show.heading: What a cleaning estimate should say
must_show.intro_html: A cleaning estimate sets the rhythm of the service. It tells the client the rooms, the task list, how often you come and who supplies what.
must_show.why_label: Why it matters before the first visit
rows: Weekly, biweekly or nightly. Price any after-hours access.
It prevents "I thought that was included".
Say who buys them, and who buys the paper goods.
Who opens the door, and the alarm code process.
How either side ends a recurring plan.

example.heading: Filled example: first deep clean, then biweekly
example.intro_html: A home client at sample prices.

line_items.heading: Cleaning services and typical prices
line_items.intro_html: Tap Add to put a line on the form. The range comes from the source in the same row. The price that the button adds is a sample inside that range, not a price recommendation.

rules.heading: Rules to check before you send a cleaning estimate

items.title: Add tax in Texas
items.html: A Texas client pays tax on building cleaning, in a home or an office, with an exception for a self-employed housekeeper employed by the household. Show the tax before signing.

items.title: Taxable for a business client too
items.html: Texas names office, warehouse, garage and restaurant cleaning in the same rule, so a commercial estimate there carries the tax line as well.

items.title: Training claims
items.html: BLS says that janitors and building cleaners typically do not need formal education to enter the occupation. Say "certified" on an estimate only when you can name the certificate.

faq.q: How do I price a house that I have not seen?
faq.a: Give a range by bedrooms and bathrooms, and confirm after a walk-through. Mark it clearly as an estimate.

faq.q: How do I quote a commercial job?
faq.a: Price per visit, then multiply by visits per month. Set the deposit to empty when you bill monthly in advance.

faq.q: Should I show a price per square foot?
faq.a: Use it if your client compares bids that way.

faq.q: What if the client wants supplies included?
faq.a: Add a supplies line, or write that you bring standard products. Say who pays for special products.
